module: File system of the crawl mode. It reads and writes the four types of JSON files of a level, in /levels/<level>/crawls/: *.trail.json (trail), *.boundary.json (boundary zone, gameplay/sites/zone object), *.path.json (path nodes) and *.startingPosition.json (starting position). Each object is loaded on demand then cached, with _filePath, _fileName, _dir and _ext added; an object's id is its file path. It also manages the player's scores per trail (best time, best penalty points, attempts), stored in settings/cloud/crawlTrails/ in freeroam or in the career profile (/career/crawlTrails/).
notes: A trail/boundary/path/startingPosition id is the full file path; its extension must be .trail.json, .boundary.json, .path.json or .startingPosition.json, otherwise loadFromFile refuses.
In a path, positions are {x,y,z} arrays in the JSON (position field) and vec3 in memory (pos field); rotations are {x,y,z,w} quaternions.
Smaller = better: bestPenaltyPoints and bestTime equal math.huge as long as no score is recorded (test with < math.huge).
The functions getAllBoundaries, getAllPaths and getAllStartingPositions take no levelPath and always list the current level; getAllTrails accepts a levelPath.
getStartingPositionById(id, trail) returns nil if trail.isFromMission is true or if the id is empty.
In career, scores are saved by onSaveCurrentProfile (if marked _dirty); outside career they are written immediately.
Inconsistency: saveCrawlData only saves trails that have an id field, whereas loaded trails use _filePath as their identifier (the id field is not set by deserializeTrail).
The cache is never automatically invalidated by a file change; use clearCache.
The constants savePathFreeroam/savePathCareer at the top of the file are commented out (reserved for future use).

getCurrentLevelCrawlPath.desc: Returns the folder of the crawl files of the current level.

returns.desc: '/levels/<level>/crawls/', or nil if no level is loaded.

clearCache.desc: Empties the cache of one type ('trails', 'boundaries', 'paths' or 'startingPositions') or of all.

type.desc: Cache key; all caches if nil.

saveTrail.desc: Serializes a trail and writes it as JSON (creating the folder if needed), then caches it.

trail.desc: Trail (name, description, pathId, boundaryId, startingPositionId, rules, prefabs...).

saveBoundary.desc: Writes a boundary zone as JSON (via boundary:onSerialize()) and caches it.

savePath.desc: Writes a path (list of nodes: name, position, rotation, radius 4.0 by default, flags) as JSON and caches it.

saveStartingPosition.desc: Writes a starting position (transform position/rotation/radius 10.0 by default, iconPosition, metadata) as JSON and caches it.

loadCrawlData.desc: Loads a crawl data file (name, description, icon, metadata, list of trail ids) and resolves each trail via getTrailById.

returns.desc: {name, description, icon ('rockCrawling01' by default), metadata, trails}.

saveCrawlData.desc: Writes a crawl data file: metadata and trail ids (see notes on the id field).

getTrailById.desc: Loads (with cache) a trail from its file path.

getBoundaryById.desc: Loads (with cache) a boundary zone, created as a zone object then deserialized.

getPathById.desc: Loads (with cache) a path; the nodes have pos (vec3), rotation (quat), radius, flags, name.

getStartingPositionById.desc: Loads (with cache) a starting position. Returns nil for a trail from a mission or an empty id.

getAllTrailFiles.desc: Lists the paths of the *.trail.json files in a folder (non-recursive).

levelPath.desc: Folder; crawl folder of the current level if nil.

getAllTrails.desc: Loads all the trails of a folder.

getAllBoundaries.desc: Loads all the boundary zones of the current level.

getAllPaths.desc: Loads all the paths of the current level.

getAllStartingPositions.desc: Loads all the starting positions of the current level.

ensurePlayerSaveDirectories.desc: Creates the freeroam save folder settings/cloud/crawlTrails/ if it does not exist.

onCareerActive.desc: Hook called when career changes state: forgets the loaded scores so they are re-read from the right folder.

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Hook called when saving the career profile: writes the modified trail scores (_dirty).

getPlayerCrawlTrailsById.desc: Loads (once) the player's scores for all trails of the current level, from the freeroam folder or the career profile.

returns.desc: Dictionary id -> {id, trail, saveData{bestTime, bestPenaltyPoints, bestTimeDate, bestPenaltyPointsDate, attempts}}.

getPlayerCrawlTrailById.desc: Returns the score data of a trail.

savePlayerCrawlTrailScoresForTrailById.desc: Marks the trail's scores as modified; outside career, writes them immediately to settings/cloud/crawlTrails/.

addNewPlayerScore.desc: Records an attempt: updates the best time (if > 0 and better), the best penalty points (if >= 0 and lower) and increments the attempt count, then saves.

returns.desc: {isNewBestTime, isNewBestPenaltyPoints, bestTime, bestPenaltyPoints}; nil if the trail is unknown (mission trail).

resetPlayerTrailScores.desc: Resets (math.huge, dates 0, attempts 0) a trail's scores and saves them.

getPlayerTrailStats.desc: Returns the player's statistics on a trail.

isTrailFromMission.desc: Indicates whether a trail comes from a mission (isFromMission).
